  "envelope_encrypt.py": "import os
import base64
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes
from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
from security_client import SecurityClients
from security_models import (
    EnvelopeEncryptRequest, EnvelopeEncryptResponse,
    EnvelopeDecryptRequest, EnvelopeDecryptResponse
)
from google.cloud import kms_v1

def _local_aes_gcm_encrypt(plaintext: bytes, key: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, bytes, bytes]:
    iv = os.urandom(12)
    cipher = Cipher(algorithms.AES(key), modes.GCM(iv), backend=default_backend())
    encryptor = cipher.encryptor()
    ciphertext = encryptor.update(plaintext) + encryptor.finalize()
    return iv, ciphertext, encryptor.tag

def _local_aes_gcm_decrypt(ciphertext: bytes, key: bytes, iv: bytes, tag: bytes) -> bytes:
    cipher = Cipher(algorithms.AES(key), modes.GCM(iv, tag), backend=default_backend())
    decryptor = cipher.decryptor()
    return decryptor.update(ciphertext) + decryptor.finalize()

def envelope_encrypt(request: EnvelopeEncryptRequest) -> EnvelopeEncryptResponse:
    kms_client = SecurityClients.get_kms_client()

    generate_response = kms_client.generate_data_encryption_key(
        name=request.key_id,
        key_generation_parameters={
            "algorithm": kms_v1.CryptoKeyVersion.CryptoKeyVersionAlgorithm.AES_256
        }
    )
    
    plaintext_dek_bytes = generate_response.plaintext
    encrypted_dek_bytes = generate_response.ciphertext

    plaintext_payload_bytes = request.plaintext.encode("utf-8")
    iv, ciphertext_payload_bytes, tag = _local_aes_gcm_encrypt(plaintext_payload_bytes, plaintext_dek_bytes)

    combined_ciphertext = iv + ciphertext_payload_bytes + tag

    return EnvelopeEncryptResponse(
        encrypted_data_key=base64.b64encode(encrypted_dek_bytes).decode("utf-8"),
        ciphertext=base64.b64encode(combined_ciphertext).decode("utf-8")
    )

def envelope_decrypt(request: EnvelopeDecryptRequest) -> EnvelopeDecryptResponse:
    kms_client = SecurityClients.get_kms_client()

    encrypted_dek_bytes = base64.b64decode(request.encrypted_data_key)
    combined_ciphertext = base64.b64decode(request.ciphertext)

    decrypt_dek_response = kms_client.decrypt(
        name=request.key_id,
        ciphertext=encrypted_dek_bytes
    )
    plaintext_dek_bytes = decrypt_dek_response.plaintext

    iv = combined_ciphertext[:12]
    ciphertext_payload_bytes = combined_ciphertext[12:-16]
    tag = combined_ciphertext[-16:]

    decrypted_payload_bytes = _local_aes_gcm_decrypt(
        ciphertext_payload_bytes, plaintext_dek_bytes, iv, tag
    )

    return EnvelopeDecryptResponse(plaintext=decrypted_payload_bytes.decode("utf-8"))

  "sign_or_verify_key.py": "import base64
import hashlib
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import padding
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature
from security_client import SecurityClients
from security_models import SignPayloadRequest, SignPayloadResponse, VerifySignatureRequest, VerifySignatureResponse

def sign_payload(request: SignPayloadRequest) -> SignPayloadResponse:
    kms_client = SecurityClients.get_kms_client()

    payload_bytes = request.payload.encode("utf-8")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload_bytes).digest()

    sign_response = kms_client.asymmetric_sign(
        name=request.key_id,
        digest={"sha256": digest}
    )

    return SignPayloadResponse(signature=base64.b64encode(sign_response.signature).decode("utf-8"))

def verify_signature(request: VerifySignatureRequest) -> VerifySignatureResponse:
    kms_client = SecurityClients.get_kms_client()

    payload_bytes = request.payload.encode("utf-8")
    signature_bytes = base64.b64decode(request.signature)

    get_public_key_response = kms_client.get_public_key(name=request.key_id)
    public_key_pem = get_public_key_response.pem.encode("utf-8")

    public_key = serialization.load_pem_public_key(public_key_pem, backend=default_backend())

    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload_bytes).digest()

    try:
        public_key.verify(
            signature_bytes,
            digest,
            padding.PKCS1v15(),
            hashes.SHA256()
        )
        is_valid = True
    except InvalidSignature:
        is_valid = False
    except Exception:
        is_valid = False

    return VerifySignatureResponse(is_valid=is_valid)

  "key_usage_summary.py": "from google.cloud import logging_v2
from google.protobuf.json_format import MessageToDict
from security_client import SecurityClients
from security_models import KeyUsageSummaryRequest, KeyUsageSummaryResponse, KeyUsageEvent
from typing import List, Dict, Any

def summarize_key_usage(request: KeyUsageSummaryRequest) -> KeyUsageSummaryResponse:
    logging_client = SecurityClients.get_logging_client()

    filter_string_parts = [
        f'resource.type="audited_resource"',
        f'resource.labels.service="cloudkms.googleapis.com"',
        f'protoPayload.@type="type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.AuditLog"',
        f'methodName:"google.cloud.kms."'
    ]

    if request.kms_key_id:
        filter_string_parts.append(f'protoPayload.resourceName:"{request.kms_key_id}"')

    if request.start_time:
        filter_string_parts.append(f'timestamp >= "{request.start_time}"')
    if request.end_time:
        filter_string_parts.append(f'timestamp <= "{request.end_time}"')

    filter_string = " AND ".join(filter_string_parts)

    events: List[KeyUsageEvent] = []
    
    for entry in logging_client.list_entries(
        resource_names=[f"projects/{request.project_id}"],
        filter=filter_string,
        page_size=request.page_size,
        page_token=request.page_token,
        order_by="timestamp desc"
    ):
        if entry.proto_payload and entry.proto_payload.type_url == "type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.AuditLog":
            audit_log_dict = MessageToDict(entry.proto_payload, preserving_proto_field_name=True)
            
            method_name = audit_log_dict.get("methodName", "N/A")
            resource_name = audit_log_dict.get("resourceName", "N/A")
            principal_email = audit_log_dict.get("authenticationInfo", {}).get("principalEmail", "N/A")
            
            events.append(KeyUsageEvent(
                timestamp=entry.timestamp.isoformat(),
                method_name=method_name,
                resource_name=resource_name,
                principal_email=principal_email,
                severity=entry.severity.name
            ))
            
    return KeyUsageSummaryResponse(events=events, next_page_token=None)

  "payload_safety.py": "from google.cloud import contentsafety_v1beta
from security_client import SecurityClients
from security_models import PayloadSafetyRequest, PayloadSafetyResponse, SafetyVerdict

def check_payload_safety(request: PayloadSafetyRequest) -> PayloadSafetyResponse:
    content_safety_client = SecurityClients.get_content_safety_client()

    parent = f"projects/{request.project_id}/locations/global"

    annotate_text_request = contentsafety_v1beta.AnnotateTextRequest(
        parent=parent,
        text_content=request.text_content
    )

    annotate_text_response = content_safety_client.annotate_text(request=annotate_text_request)

    verdicts = []
    for detection in annotate_text_response.v2_detections:
        verdicts.append(SafetyVerdict(
            severity_score=detection.severity_score,
            category=detection.category.name
        ))

    is_blocked = any(v.severity_score > 0 for v in verdicts)

    return PayloadSafetyResponse(verdicts=verdicts, blocked=is_blocked)
